note: Independent rejudge against RFC 2866 Section 4.1 ("For retransmissions where the contents are identical, the Identifier MUST remain unchanged. Note that if Acct-Delay-Time is included in the attributes of an Accounting-Request then the Acct-Delay-Time value will be updated when the packet is retransmitted, changing the content of the Attributes field and requiring a new Identifier and Request Authenticator."). TestRFC2866AccountingRetransmitTakesANewIdentifierAndRequestAuthenticator changed only a comment (Exchange->exchange in 69f3e72365); with 1100ms timeout it verifies Acct-Delay-Time actually changes, Identifier changes, Request Authenticator changes, and both authenticators match independent Section 3 MD5. TestRFC2866AccountingRetransmitWithoutDelayTimeKeepsIdentifier proves identical-contents retransmission (OmitAcctDelayTime=true) keeps the exact Identifier and byte-identical datagram via exchange/stampsAcctDelayTime. TestRFC2866AccountingRetransmitTakesANewIdentifier (150ms sub-second timeout) and TestRFC2866AccountingDistinctRequestsDifferIdentifier remain unchanged. Verdict enforced stands.
